He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Arkansas Razorbacks men's basketball|Arkansas Razorbacks]]. ==High school career== Moody began playing high school basketball for [[Parkview Arts and Science Magnet High School]] in [[Little Rock, Arkansas]], where he helped his team reach the state championship game in his freshman season.{{cite web |title=Moses Moody inks with Razorbacks |url=https://www.thv11.com/article/sports/moses-moody-inks-with-razorbacks/91-cee3135a-efc1-4e30-9030-79eaab3e8319 |publisher=[[KTHV]] |accessdate=July 8, 2020 |date=April 17, 2020}} As a sophomore, he moved to [[North Little Rock High School]] in [[North Little Rock, Arkansas]]. Moody averaged 18.6 points, 7.2 rebounds, 3.1 assists, 2.1 steals and 1.4 blocks per game, leading his team to the Class 7A state title.{{cite web |last1=Parker |first1=Zach |title=Moody shines as NLR pays back Northside |url=https://www.hotsr.com/news/2018/mar/09/moody-shines-as-nlr-pays-back-northside/ |website=[[Hot Springs Sentinel-Record]] |accessdate=July 8, 2020 |date=March 9, 2018}} He was named to the ''[[Arkansas Democrat-Gazette]]'' All-Underclassman Team and the Arkansas 7A All-State Team.{{cite web |last1=Davenport |first1=Richard |title=Moses Moody feels the love from Arkansas staff and fans |url=https://www.arkansasonline.com/news/2019/oct/20/moses-moody-feels-love-arkansas-staff-and-fans/ |website=[[Arkansas Democrat-Gazette]] |accessdate=July 8, 2020 |date=October 20, 2019}} For his junior year, Moody transferred to [[Montverde Academy]] in [[Montverde, Florida]]. He averaged 17.7 points, 3.9 rebounds, 1.5 assists and 1.6 steals per game for Bradley Beal Elite at the [[Nike Elite Youth Basketball League]] (EYBL) regular season and was named to the All-EYBL honorable mention.{{cite web |last1=Davenport |first1=Richard |title=ESPN's Biancardi: A lot to like about Moses Moody |url=https://www.nwaonline.com/news/2019/nov/09/lot-about-moses-moody-said-espns-paul-biancardi/ |website=[[The Northwest Arkansas Times]] |accessdate=July 8, 2020 |date=November 9, 2019}} In his senior season, Moody averaged 11.6 points 3.3 rebounds and 1.8 assists per game for Montverde, the consensus number one team in the nation, who he helped achieve a 25–0 regular season record. ===Recruiting=== Moody received several high major [[NCAA Division I]] scholarship offers as early as his sophomore season.{{cite web |last1=Davenport |first1=Richard |title=NLR's Moody more of complete player since beginning of the season |url=https://www.arkansasonline.com/news/2018/mar/04/nlrs-moses-moody-more-complete-player-beginning-se/ |website=[[Arkansas Democrat-Gazette]] |accessdate=July 8, 2020 |date=March 4, 2018}} He finished high school as a consensus four-star recruit in the 2020 class. On November 9, 2019, Moody committed to play [[college basketball]] for [[Arkansas Razorbacks men's basketball|Arkansas]] over offers from [[Michigan Wolverines men's basketball|Michigan]] and [[Virginia Cavaliers men's basketball|Virginia]], among others. He became the highest ranked player to commit to Arkansas since [[Bobby Portis]] of the 2013 class.{{cite web |last1=Borzello |first1=Jeff |title=Moses Moody, No. 29 in ESPN 100, picks Arkansas over Michigan |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/28044301/moses-moody-no-29-espn-100-picks-arkansas-michigan |publisher=[[ESPN]] |accessdate=July 8, 2020 |date=November 9, 2019}} {{College Athlete Recruit Start|40=no|collapse=no|year=2020}} {{College Athlete Recruit Entry | recruit = Moses Moody | position = [[Shooting guard|SG]] | hometown = [[Little Rock, Arkansas|Little Rock, AR]] | highschool = [[Montverde Academy]] (FL) | feet = 6 | inches = 6 | weight = 185 | 40 = | commitdate = November 9, 2019 | scout stars = | rivals stars = 4 | 247 stars = 4 | espn stars = 4 | espn grade = 87 }} {{College Athlete Recruit End | 40 = | year = 2020 | rivals ref title = Arkansas 2020 Basketball Commitments | scout ref title = | espn ref title = 2020 Arkansas Razorbacks Recruiting Class | rivals school = arkansas | scout s = | espn schoolid = 8 | 247 overall = 39 | rivals overall = 55 | espn overall = 45 | accessdate = July 7, 2020 | bball = yes }} ==College career== On March 13, 2021, Moody recorded a career-high 28 points and nine rebounds in a 78–71 loss to [[LSU Tigers basketball|LSU]] at the [[2021 SEC Men's Basketball Tournament|SEC Tournament]] semifinals.
